amplification: First mean absolute aligned-text error > 1e-3, and full per-layer values; diagnostic marker does not replace acceptance
factor_gate: Do all four frozen diagnostic comparisons even when an old numeric threshold fails; do not stop first comparison
first_divergence: First layer then execution-order operator with any nonzero aligned text error; also report all common positions before exit and P-1 separately
gpu_budget: Freeze absolute start and +2h deadline before first GPU; new GPU work stops 30min before; never reset on retries

operator_diagnostics.selection: Choose lowest-overhead form attaining exact same-input component agreement; never choose by answer or Accuracy. Padding candidate must retain material physical reductions and disclose dummy work; no nearly-dense restoration accepted.

probe_gate: Every effective logit vector with/without probes torch.equal; invalid probes stop diagnostic analysis
probe_revision_2: All heads at L1/L22 only, remaining layers frozen heads0/16/31; archive actual cache tensors at each layer after prefill and decode
raw_attention_queries: retained original text positions, with P-1 separately labelled; all heads summarized, raw selected heads only
raw_tensor_storage: Private /data experiment resource directory; per-file SHA, shape and dtype indexed; do not claim Git contains external arrays
repair_policy: Only after first divergence located; no threshold/layer/prompt/dtype/weight changes; no nearly-dense fallback accepted as physical fix
score_probe: Replay same full QK GEMM shape; verify replay softmax equals actual returned probabilities; only then archive selected text queries/heads

shadow.inputs: Frozen F operator input, compare full122 vs prefix121 at L1-L6 attention ops; full122 vs original text26 at L22-L23; identical shared input rows
shadow.precision: BF16 unchanged; local FP32 operator diagnostic permitted, not a candidate replacement

stop: No formal accuracy or latency benchmark under any outcome; any repair-original-case failure stops expanding samples
success_status: NUMERICAL_SMOKE_VALIDATED only if original then all fixed cases pass on authorized cards

tolerances.action: Any failure stops both workers before pilot/main/performance; do not relax
